claim: 公开数据库包含820条实验电导记录、来自214个来源，并覆盖403个具有近室温电导的独特组成。
quote: This dataset has 820 entries collected from 214 sources; ... There are 403 unique chemical compositions with an associated ionic conductivity near room temperature (15–35 °C).
scope: 固态电解质电导数据库
ui_use: 数据来源与候选空间说明

claim: 每条记录包含化学组成、结构标签以及特定温度下的离子电导率。
quote: entries contain a chemical composition, an expert-assigned structural label, and ionic conductivity at a specific temperature (from 5 to 873 °C)

claim: 无监督筛选发现16种新的快离子导体，电导范围约10^-4至10^-1 S cm^-1。
quote: Our unsupervised learning scheme discovers 16 new fast Li-conductors with conductivities of 10−4–10−1 S cm−1
ui_use: 文献先验与候选优先级

claim: 体心立方阴离子堆积提供更平坦的能量景观和约0.2 eV的低迁移势垒。
quote: the structural framework with body-centred cubic (bcc) anion packing yields the flattest energy landscape with the lowest Li+ migration barrier, for example, ∼0.2 eV

claim: 高性能固态电解质通常需要约10^-3 S cm^-1的室温离子电导和低于10^-8 S cm^-1的电子电导。
quote: High ionic conductivity of 10−3 S cm−1 at room temperature, low electronic conductivity of <10−8 S cm−1

claim: LLZO中的锂枝晶可沿晶界形成和传播，因此仅优化体相离子电导不足以保证器件安全。
quote: Li dendrites formed and propagated between the electrolyte grains along grain boundaries

claim: Al掺杂可稳定立方相并提高致密度；0.25 mol Al样品在该研究中电导最高。
quote: The results indicated that the sample containing 0.25 mole Al sample had the highest ionic conductivity.

claim: 加入0.25 mol Al后相对密度由82.4%提高到90.1%，继续增加Al则下降。
quote: The density is increased from 82.4% to 90.1%, and hardness is promoted from 664 to 711 HV, by adding 0.25 mole of Al

claim: 过量Al可能在晶界偏析并提高活化能，说明最优掺杂量受晶界和烧结共同影响。
quote: The excess Al can segregate at the grain boundary ... This behavior seems to increase the activation energy

claim: Li6.6La3Zr1.6Nb0.4O12在1200℃烧结30 min时总离子电导为5.09×10^-4 S cm^-1，活化能0.311 eV，相对密度87.3%。
quote: The total ionic conductivity of samples sintered at 1200 °C for 30 min was 5.09 × 10−4 S∙cm−1, the activation energy was 0.311 eV, and the relative density was 87.3%.

claim: 1150℃烧结60 min获得90.4%相对密度，但电导为3.49×10^-4 S cm^-1，说明更高致密度不等于更高电导。
quote: the total ionic conductivity was 3.49 × 10−4 S∙cm−1, the activation energy was 0.316 eV, and the relative density was 90.4%.

claim: 实际制备引入的晶界和界面会扰动本征传导通道。
quote: practical processing and synthesis routes introduce grain boundaries and other interfaces that can perturb primary conduction channels.

claim: 原子尺度与介观微结构共同解释文献中LLZO电导的显著差异。
quote: Our results provide fundamental understanding of the physical origins of the reported variability in ionic conductivities

claim: 高阻晶界是LLZO薄膜Li+传输的瓶颈；引入非晶畴降低晶界迁移势垒后，电导达到6.36×10^-4 S cm^-1。
quote: The high-resistive grain boundaries are the bottleneck ... the presented LLZO thin film exhibits a cutting-edge value of ionic conductivity as high as 6.36 × 10−4 S/cm

claim: Li6.4Ga0.2La3Zr2O12经两步烧结后达到97.3%相对密度和1.24×10^-3 S cm^-1室温电导。
quote: Pellets with the composition of Li6.4Ga0.2La3Zr2O12 deliver pure garnet phase, uniform fine grains, high relative density of 97.3% and conductivity of 1.24 × 10−3 S cm−1 at 27 °C

claim: 两步烧结可抑制异常晶粒长大；该样品同时具有均匀晶粒、高致密度和高离子电导。
quote: The sample sintered at 1150 °C for 1 min and 1000 °C for 3 h exhibits high Li-ion conductivity ... uniform grain size, and high relative density of 97.3%

claim: SPS处理的Ta取代LLZT在保持结构稳定的同时获得高离子电导。
quote: SPS processed Li7−xLa3Zr1.5Ta0.5O12−δ showed the high ionic conductivity without structural decomposition.
ui_use: 烧结方式对电导的影响

claim: Li2O气氛烧结可得到97–98%相对密度、约10^-3 S cm^-1电导和0.9 mA cm^-2临界电流密度。
quote: relative densities of 97–98%, conductivities of ~1 × 10−3 S cm−1 at 25 °C, critical current density of 0.9 mA cm−2
ui_use: 最高致密与器件相关指标

claim: 同一论文的A样品致密度为97%，B样品仅66%，说明烧结气氛可造成显著微结构差异。
quote: A relative density (RD) of 97% can be obtained for pellet A ... pellet B ... exhibited a low RD of 66%

claim: Ga掺杂LLZO的室温电导提高到1.46 mS cm^-1，并强调Ga对Li位迁移的活化作用。
quote: the lithium-ion conductivity of LLZO at room temperature is improved to 1.46 mS/cm through Ga-doping

claim: Li6.20Ga0.30La2.95Rb0.05Zr2O12的室温总电导为1.62 mS cm^-1。
Nb掺杂LLZNO颗粒充分连接，实测相对密度达到99.5%。
quote: consistent with the very high measured relative density of 99.5%

claim: 三元掺杂LGLBZTO在室温达到0.72 mS cm^-1，并在60℃达到1.24 mS cm^-1。
quote: exhibited the highest total ionic conductivity of 0.72 and 1.24 mS cm−1 at room temperature and 60 °C, respectively

claim: 控制干燥氧气气氛可抑制吸湿降解，并获得1.3和2.2 mS cm^-1的24℃和42℃总电导。
quote: Control of the sintering conditions by using a dry O2 atmosphere ... total conductivities as high as 1.3 and 2.2 mS cm−1 at 24 and 42 °C

claim: 吸湿导致H+/Li+交换，质子化区域深入1.35 μm，并使Li迁移能力约下降3倍。
quote: proton-exchanged region ... extend as far as 1.35 μm ... correlated to a 3-fold decrease in the Li mobility

claim: Ta含量显著改变电导与相对密度；例如Li6.8La3Zr1.8Ta0.2O12仅74%致密度和1.1×10^-6 S cm^-1总电导。
Mo6+取代LLZM在1150℃经FAST烧结后得到>95%相对密度和1.3×10^-4 S cm^-1室温总电导。
quote: maximum relative density of >95% with a total ionic conductivity as high as 1.3 × 10−4 S cm−1

claim: 本场景从公开石榴石数据中筛选20–35℃记录，共172条，来自67篇来源论文，并保留每条记录的原始DOI。
quote: Filtered source file: garnet_data_65.csv; room-temperature interval 20–35 °C; source DOI retained per row.
